notes.title: Bridge World Update
notes.notes: Size change to the bridge world for better gameplay.

notes.title: Finger Trees Update
notes.notes:
The ability to view your objectives have been added so dialogue is no longer the only thing you have to rely on. In addition the flamethrower weapon has been fixed from crashing. Also drop rates for flamethrower have been changed. 

In addition weapons found that are the same kind as you are carrying will now no longer require you to pick them up and will instead automatically be added to your current ammo.

notes.title: Finger Trees-Nurse Update
notes.notes: For the nurse update a new character, the nurse has been added. The nurse will provide additional health throughout the bridge worlds. In addition, modifications have been made to weapon damage as well as enemies behavior. Please enjoy.

notes.title: Finger Trees Update
